traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/022.0-DEV-JSDOC-COEXISTENCE.story.md is fully implemented. The `valid-annotation-format` rule now uses `normalizeCommentLine` plus the new `isNonTraceabilityJSDocTagLine` helper and updated `processCommentLine` logic to (1) treat any non-traceability JSDoc tag line starting with `@` as a boundary that finalizes the current @story/@req value, (2) only continue multiline values on lines that do not start with a JSDoc tag, and (3) avoid concatenating JSDoc tags into requirement IDs or story paths. Tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts cover traceability annotations before, after, and interleaved with other JSDoc tags, including multiline story values and the specific regression case from Issue #3 (no longer producing `REQ-OPTIMIZATION@param{object}data`). Documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md has a dedicated "JSDoc coexistence" section with concrete examples that match the acceptance criteria. All Jest test suites pass, including the new tests for this story, and existing tests from dependent stories continue to pass, indicating backward compatibility. Therefore, all acceptance criteria for this story are satisfied.
